summary: Payette NF lookout built in 1933 near McCall, Idaho; tower dismantled in 2000, with the cab and 10 feet rebuilt on the Central Idaho Historical Museum grounds.

facts.design: 72-foot Aermotor tower with a 7x7 metal cab, plus a log cabin residence
facts.agency: Payette National Forest (original site); the Central Idaho Historical Museum administers the register entry

access.note: Stands on the museum grounds in McCall; no source says whether the cab can be entered

facts.status_note: The 72-foot tower came down in 2000; the museum has the rebuilt cab and about 10 feet of tower, per the Register

events.note: Built with a log cabin residence and a 72-foot Aermotor tower; materials hauled in by wagon
Marker gives 1934 as the start of staffing
Marker gives 1970 as the last staffed year; the Register says staffed into the 1970s
Tower dismantled by volunteers; cab and 10 feet rebuilt at the Central Idaho Historical Museum in McCall
Added to the National Historic Lookout Register

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register says staffed into the 1970s; the marker gives 1934 to 1970; Idaho Fire Lookouts says the 1970s. The story gives the sources' different dates and does not pick one.
A museum visitor listing describes an Aeromotor cab and tower on display; the Register says the rebuilt piece is the cab and 10 feet of tower. The story reports both.

sources.title: Sloans Creek Point Fire Lookout Tower
McCall History & Museums: Central Idaho Historical Museum

notes_for_editor: Staffing end date and the museum display differ across sources; both are reported in the story. Elevation conflicts: the Register gives 5,021 ft (1,530 m), Idaho Fire Lookouts and the marker give 6,280 ft; not used. The record's coordinates are roughly 20 km southeast of McCall, which fits the original site (firelookout.com says 14 miles southeast), not the museum; no correction proposed. The record's events text ('None relocated...') is a note rather than an event, so it was not used. The brief's source_pages point to a separate museum-site record (us-id-sloans-creek-point-at-cent-id-hist-museum); it may be a duplicate and should be checked. No source read describes the original site today. Used 6 page reads and 1 search.
